principle: Language is unrestricted; source class is restricted. Arabic and French have equal admissibility.

allowed_source_classes.definition: Official Moroccan public institutions, constitutional bodies, ministries, Parliament, SGG/official legal publication, election administration, territorial public authorities, or official public datasets.
allowed_source_classes.admissibility: Allowed as primary evidence. The page/document must itself be attributable to the official body.

allowed_source_classes.definition: Website controlled by a legally recognized Moroccan political party.
allowed_source_classes.admissibility: Allowed for party-controlled facts such as nominations, endorsements, internal office, candidacy announcements and official party positions. For identity/territory resolution or externally verifiable factual claims, require corroboration by T0 or MEDIAS24 unless the party page reproduces an official document.
Allowed as the only non-official media source in E_collect V1. Historical archived copies are allowed if provenance and capture date are preserved.

disallowed: Social media posts, even from official accounts, unless the same claim is available on an allowed website
Blogs, forums, aggregators and anonymous pages
LLM-generated summaries or transliterations as evidence
new_domain_rule: A newly discovered domain may be used only if it objectively qualifies under T0_OFFICIAL_INSTITUTIONAL or T1_OFFICIAL_PARTY before claim extraction. Record qualification evidence in the run source registry. No new source class may be introduced during the run.
archive_rule: An archived page inherits the source class of the original domain; the archive is transport/provenance, not a new source class.

claim_verification_rules.territory_alias_or_cross_language_identi: One T0 source explicitly connecting the forms, OR two independent allowed sources with at least one T0.
claim_verification_rules.party_nomination_or_internal_party_offic: One T1 official party source is sufficient for the party's own announcement, but status must be labeled PARTY_ANNOUNCED unless a T0 source establishes legal registration.
claim_verification_rules.party_switch_or_defection: T0, or T1 plus independent MEDIAS24/T0 corroboration.
claim_verification_rules.historical_candidate_fact: Prefer T0; if absent, two independent allowed sources are required.
